test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: The simple mistake which was committed by the boy haunted him for years.
An simple mistake which was committed by the boy haunted her for years.
A simple mistake which was committed by an boy haunted her for years.
The simple mistake which was committed by an boy haunted her for years.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This sentence in **Option 1 is grammatically correct.**
 
• It correctly uses "the" before "simple mistake," appropriately specifying a part
